overview: Based on the published agenda, the Wausau School District Board of Education was scheduled to hold a regular meeting to consider routine personnel and financial matters, approve the 2026-2027 budget and tax levy, and review the 2025-2026 seclusion and restraint report. The meeting was expected to address preliminary budget projections based on a 4.03% estimated increase in equalized property values and set the date for the annual budget hearing.

agenda.item: Excellence in Action: Wausau School Foundation
Appointments (Additional Staff, Replacement Staff, Contract Increases)
Minutes: Regular Session of August 10, 2026, and Special Session of August 24, 2026
Payment of Bills/Budget Status and Investment Report
Set Annual Meeting Date and Location
Board Member Professional Growth & Development Report

discussions.body: Dr. Elizabeth Channel, Assistant Superintendent of Operations, was scheduled to present a summary report of legal counsel expenses incurred during 2025-2026, separated by law firm and type of legal advice sought. This was a written report requiring no action and was estimated to take 1 minute to present.
The Board was expected to review and potentially approve a list of legal firms used by the District for various legal needs. The presentation was estimated to take 1 minute.

discussions.item: Set Annual Meeting Date and Location
discussions.body: The Committee of the Whole was expected to recommend a date, time, and location for the budget hearing and annual meeting to ensure compliance with statutory requirements (s.120.08(1)(a)) for an annual meeting between May 15 and October 31. This procedural item was estimated to take 1 minute.

The District was scheduled to present projected property value changes, with an estimated increase of 4.03% for the 2026-27 mill rate calculation purposes. Since certified property value would not be available until October 1, the projected value was expected to be used for the initial budget and during the annual meeting.

Dr. Elizabeth Channel was scheduled to present the 2026-27 Budget Booklet for Board consideration, with a preliminary budget recommendation for use at the Budget Hearing and Annual Meeting. The presentation was estimated to take 2 minutes.
The Board was expected to consider the tax levy corresponding to the 2026-27 budget for presentation at the Budget Hearing and Annual Meeting. This presentation was estimated to take 2 minutes.

An overview presentation of the 2025-26 Seclusion and Restraint report with a brief analysis of data over time was scheduled, with an estimated presentation time of 10 minutes. The full report was included in the meeting attachments.

publicComment: A public and student comment period was included on this agenda.
